entries.specific_competence: Perform different tests to identify types of fibres using different methods (physical inspection, microscope, burning, chemical)
entries.learning_activity:
Brainstorming: Guide the students to brainstorm the different methods used for identifying textiles fibres
Demonstration: Show the student examples of fibre tests using different methods
Laboratory work: Task the students to conduct various fibre tests by using various methods and record their findings accordingly
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Guide the students to brainstorm the different methods used for identifying textiles fibres
Demonstration: Show the student examples of fibre tests using different methods
Laboratory work: Task the students to conduct various fibre tests by using various methods and record their findings accordingly
entries.assessment: Different tests for identifying types of fibres are performed correctly using different methods
entries.references: TIE, Textiles and Garment Construction for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: (b) Decorate fabrics, using dyeing, printing and painting techniques
entries.learning_activity:
Brainstorming: Guide the students to identify resources used for decorating fabrics using dyeing, printing and painting techniques
Practical work: Guide the students to decorate fabrics using dyeing and printing techniques
Gallery work: Guide the student to display their work for gallery walk to observe and share experiences
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Guide the students to identify resources used for decorating fabrics using dyeing, printing and painting techniques
Practical work: Guide the students to decorate fabrics using dyeing and printing techniques
Gallery work: Guide the student to display their work for gallery walk to observe and share experiences
entries.assessment: Fabrics are decorated properly by using dyeing, printing and painting techniques
resources: video clip showing dyeing, printing and painting different articles

entries.specific_competence: (c) Use decorated fabric to construct own garment taking into consideration elements and principles of design
entries.learning_activity:
Observation: Organise the students in manageable groups and provide them with various garment to identify elements of designs
Exploration: Guide the students to explore how the element and principle of design affect the construction of any garment
Hands-on-activity: Using decorated fabric, assign each student to construct own garment by considering the elements and principles of design
teaching_learning_activities: Observation: Organise the students in manageable groups and provide them with various garment to identify elements of designs
Exploration: Guide the students to explore how the element and principle of design affect the construction of any garment
Hands-on-activity: Using decorated fabric, assign each student to construct own garment by considering the elements and principles of design
entries.assessment: Garments are constructed properly using the decorated fabric taking into considerations the elements and principles of design
entries.references: TIE, Textiles and Garment Construction for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: 1.3 Design and construct traditional clothing from selected ethnic groups in Tanzania
entries.learning_activity:
(a) Explore traditional garments from selected ethnic groups in Tanzania (materials and designs used) Think-Pair-Share: Provide students with various traditional garments found in Tanzania to identify both their origin and materials used to make such designs
Exploration: Assign the students to make use of online/offline sources to search more traditional garments. Guide them to present their work in plenary discussion
teaching_learning_activities: Think-Pair-Share: Provide students with various traditional garments found in Tanzania to identify both their origin and materials used to make such designs
Exploration: Assign the students to make use of online/offline sources to search more traditional garments. Guide them to present their work in plenary discussion
entries.assessment: Traditional garments from different tribes are explored correctly
resources: Chart or pictures showing different traditional garments and video clips showing culture for different tribes
entries.references: TIE, Textiles and Garment Construction for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Use ICT in textile design and garment construction
entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Use ICT in textile design and garment construction
entries.learning_activity:
(a) Create fabric design patterns using CAD/ CAM/ CIM (graphic representation, regular repeating patterns and colour design) Brainstorming: Guide the students to identify different types of computer pattern design software
Demonstration: In manageable groups, demonstrate to the students how to develop various fabric design patterns using the existing computer design software
Practical Work: Task the students to create any fabric design pattern of their choice using computer design software
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Guide the students to identify different types of computer pattern design software
Demonstration: In manageable groups, demonstrate to the students how to develop various fabric design patterns using the existing computer design software
Practical Work: Task the students to create any fabric design pattern of their choice using computer design software
entries.assessment: Fabric design pattens are created correctly using CAD/ CAM/CIM system
resources: catalogue instructional manuals and Interactive tools/ audio visual tutorials
entries.references: TIE, Textiles and Garment Construction for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
